rules.rule: Restore original designer parent intent and raw child draft across genuine browser reload without creating or replaying business commands
rules.source: Approved BA100/PR-E true browser reload parent/child draft and unknown-command recovery; independently reviewed PO customer decision supplement Library55db9bd20f8481919bb984a22b3d0027; coordinator explicitly requires actor/order/request/direction/key/hash, current read rights only, no POST replay and newer-draft protection.
rules.initialization: Actual merged1026 release base d64be1e79010c1bdea8a0215b181a3bd88f4b7cb with original service/role/schema and browser state. Same-tab actor/environment/object-scoped storage; current authorization rechecked before restore and server read. No new schema or migration, production data change, implicit business creation, plan adoption or timing recalculation. Current cancellation and washing navigation/forecast source remains intact; the actual merged base is recorded for this publication.
rules.dateAndPermission: Raw draft, normalized immutable sent command and minimal confirmed receipt are distinct. Never invent key/source/version for a pure draft; never replace or replay an unknown original. GET receipt requires current authorized object read plus original actor/namespace/order/request/direction/key/hash, not retained write/approval power. No historical body/credentials/roles returned. Later draft or independent unknown cannot be cleared; absent or failed read is not proof of failure.
rules.expectation: Original development/certain-order/preorder parent intent and raw values/row identities survive actual page.reload with zero automatic writes beyond1200ms. Explicit original save alone creates, exact acknowledged source is reused. Unknown creation remains blocked; original publish/confirm each recover through exact original-key GET without another POST. Known source acknowledgement remains durable if following read fails. Unretained local file bytes require explicit reselection; legacy live C/D/E/F/PACKSTOP terminals are not inferred. In the same SPA tab, closing and reopening a bound draft verifies the authoritative source/version before editing, continues across multiple saves, and preserves the local draft without mutating a newer server version. The local-only view identity uses the browser compatibility provider; a missing native randomUUID neither prevents a raw draft from restoring nor generates a business key.

rules.expectation: Original raw incomplete form restores after reload with no autosave. Server-committed but browser503 save and PO decision each use one original-key readonly GET, no duplicate PUT/POST. Confirm minimal success before optional latest-sheet read, preserve later draft and another unresolved envelope, keep known success on subsequent read failure. Future/corrupt/unwritable storage and changed version/round block replacement or implicit submission.

rules.expectation: Save and decision namespaces never mix. Readonly RR transaction checks current access before original actor/key lookup; request/direction/hash mismatch stays unconfirmed and historical body never leaves API. Genuine approval revocation preserves receipt read in the same session, object-read revocation then denies; foreign object/actor/key denies. Business command/audit/plan state remains unchanged by GET. Original transaction refusal and post-commit sheet-read failure remain distinct.
